mentions.name: Audioguidekit
mentions.description: An open-source, React-based audio player built primarily for museums and tour guides. Its flexible design and architecture let it deliver sequential audio guides and support any use-case that requires sequential audio playback.
mentions.problem: Museums and tour guides needed a suitable tool for delivering sequential audio guides; the author built it to scratch their own itch in that industry.
mentions.audience: Museums and tour guides, plus any use-case where sequential audio needs to be delivered.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://audioguidekit.org

It is a React-based OSS audio player I developed primarily for museums and tour guides as I am really close to this industry and i was trying to scratch my own itch. In practice, thanks to the flexible design and architecture, it can be used for any use-case where you need to deliver sequential audio.
